legend.status: Implemented | Partial | Missing | Reference-only (current frontend implementation of the screen)
legend.classification: A existing functional | B existing partial | C UI reference only (no workflow yet) | D unsupported capability (needs backend)
legend.backendSupport: Existing | Partial | Missing | Not required (judged from handwritten api-client operations; see discrepancy DR-003)
legend.priority: P0 foundation | P1 redesign of live flows | P2 missing screen with backend support or low risk | P3 blocked on backend/product
legend.qa: FE-UI-016 per-screen result: surface (route | dialog-on-route | preview-composition | pattern-component | layout-pattern | reference | development-preview-route), deployedRoute (null = no production route), reference-file dispositions, axe/overflow after fixes, result (pass | pass-after-fix | gap | reference-reviewed). Evidence: final-visual-qa.json. implementation.status is historical per ticket; use qa.surface/deployedRoute for what is deployed.

screens.name: User detail

existingFunctionality: Trello FE-UI-013: feature-local AdminUserDetailScreen (identity header with status/email badges and actions, account key-values, role chips with remove and an assign control, KYC and subscription summaries, active sessions, security activity, per-section loading/error/unavailable/empty, not found, forbidden). Lock/unlock, sign out all and role changes open AdminStepUpDialog; revoking one session opens ConfirmDialog; opening a confirmation captures the intent with its explicit target (userId plus role or session id); the confirmation closes with a notice if the displayed user, account status, role or session no longer matches, and the intent is re-checked before submitting; one request at a time; failures keep the dialog open with safe copy from describeAdminActionFailure for a retry; success closes it without showing success or changing the record. Without a handler every action is disabled with an explanation. No route, navigation item or production import; rendered only by its app tests from typed preview fixtures (Trello FE-UI-013, design ad9386e).

uiGaps: Route /users/[userId], adapter and real lock/unlock, session revocation and role assignment mutations with a backend step-up contract.
notes: Which actions require step-up, and whether a reason is recorded, is a backend contract decision (DR-072, DR-112).

screens.name: Forgot password (email and code steps)

existingFunctionality: Trello FE-UI-020 (design ad9386e): one public route; email step requests a 6-digit code through the same-origin BFF (unknown emails answered like accepted requests), then the code, new password and confirmation are submitted together; resend and Change email; 'Forgot password?' on sign-in.

missingCapabilities: No resend cooldown, retry-at or code-expiry value in the request response; a repeated request while a code is still active sends nothing (DR-015)

uiGaps: The illustrative 'Resend code in 0:45' timer is not shown: the backend returns no cooldown; resend is always available and explains that an unexpired code stays valid.
Copy does not claim delivery or that the address has an account ('If an account uses …').
notes: /forgot-password is in the proxy's exact PUBLIC_PATHS; the matcher is unchanged.
No reset link, URL token or separate /reset-password route: the design's email-OTP flow replaces them.

screens.name: Reset password (code, invalid code, done)

existingFunctionality: Trello FE-UI-020 (design ad9386e): code, new password and confirmation in one form (no auto-submit); one combined 'That code didn't work' state (new code via Resend code); field-mapped backend validation; success only after the backend confirms, then Sign in.
